readbacks.sql_literal: SELECT codigo,categoria,severidad,primera_vez FROM transversal.error_knowledge WHERE codigo IN ('IG-M107-SOAK-CRITERION-DRIFT-001','IG-M107-CP2-READ-ROLE-CURRENTNESS-001') AND primera_vez<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00' ORDER BY codigo

SELECT payload->>'test_case_count' test_case_count,payload->>'trigger_binding_count' trigger_binding_count,payload->>'source_pack_version' source_pack,payload->>'acceptance_declared' acceptance_declared FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161 AND created_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00'

SELECT evento_tipo,entidad_codigo,count(*) AS n FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE created_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00' AND (entidad_codigo ILIKE '%M9.11%' OR descripcion ILIKE '%SOAK_OBSERVATION_HISTORY_V2%') GROUP BY 1,2 LIMIT 15

SELECT id,receipt_kind,subject_ref,payload->>'verification_status' verification_status,payload->>'screens_total' screens,payload->>'families_total' families,payload->>'known_false_pass_signals' false_pass,payload->>'unresolved_d4' d4 FROM programacion.provenance_receipts WHERE id=38 AND created_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00'
SELECT payload->'usage_stats'->>'track_functions' track_functions,payload->'usage_stats'->>'ig_stat_rows' stat_rows FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161
SELECT current_user principal,current_setting('transaction_read_only') read_only FROM pg_settings LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'definition_md5' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$') md5_format_valid FROM public.lf_eventos e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE e.id=20161
